info.title: Configo
info.description: The Configo CLI tool. Run 'configo schema generate' to generate an appsettings JSON schema for your application.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate an appsettings JSON schema for the target application.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the .csproj file or the directory that contains it.
Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path for the generated schema file.
Overrides the path the application would otherwise choose.
Can be absolute or relative to the current directory.
